title: What UTV 1.0 does not do yet

entities.title: A complete design, implemented in part
entities.summary: UTV 1.0 is a complete design specification; the libraries implement an everyday subset, and anything outside it returns unsupported.
entities.impact: Recurrences, uncertainty, series, history, business calendars, logical clocks and most of the 26 kinds have a wire form and semantics but no library operations; a caller gets unsupported, never a guess.
entities.workaround: Hold such values as UTV JSON; each library's JSON layer validates their structure.

relationships.description: Implementation was allowed to lag the design.

entities.title: The semantic scenarios are requirements, not tests
entities.summary: The 94 semantic scenarios in conformance/scenarios/ have no inputs, contexts or expected results, so no implementation can be checked against them.
entities.impact: No library can claim a conformance profile by passing the semantic scenarios, and none may reach 1.0.0 until it does (VERSIONING.md).

entities.title: The schema checks shapes only
entities.summary: A value can pass the JSON Schema and still be semantically invalid or unresolvable.
entities.impact: Structural validation is not a conformance claim: calendar correctness, graph consistency, registration, cross-field arithmetic and adapters need semantic conformance tests.
